content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-462. - I.P.M.C. Section 103.1, General.
content.summary:
Section 103.1. General,
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
103.1. General.
The official in charge of property maintenance inspection shall be known as the code
                  official."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
